payload.summary: Implemented Feature 5: Added get_image_mimetype() method to ImageBlock in types.py for lazy MIME type evaluation and caching via resolve_image(). Decoupled MIME type resolution from image_to_base64() by removing inline guessing logic. Added comprehensive unit tests in test_types.py covering lazy evaluation from raw bytes, file path, and URL, handling predefined mimetypes, caching, and unknown formats. Verified clean merge with origin/agent2 with zero conflicts and all 20 tests passing.

payload.summary: Added encoding field (Literal['base64', 'raw'] = 'base64') to ImageBlock in llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py. Updated image_to_base64() to bypass base64 encoding when encoding == 'raw', and updated resolve_image() to return BytesIO(self.image) when raw (and base64-encoded bytes when as_base64=True). Added unit tests in test_types.py covering default encoding, explicit base64, raw encoding, resolve_image with raw encoding, and ValidationError for invalid encoding. All 14 tests pass on agent2 branch and all 20 tests pass when merged with agent1 with 0 conflicts.
